notes.title: GUNPIG v1.10 released!
notes.notes:
UPDATE v1.10 of GUNPIG is now live!

-adjusted tank motion curve for smoother tank movement
-new enemy:  'poppers', appear in bunches in early levels, dangerous in swarms, fun to shoot!
-boss door alert strips:  WARNING!
-animated buff effects on tank for energy and sheild regeneration and double damage
-Bonus Levels!  Take a break, blow up some big red barrels and collect some classic game carts!
-general refinements and de-buggery

Enjoy!
